downloads_provenance.note: Raw downloads are gitignored (data/raw/ and *.gtf.gz in .gitignore) and are NOT committed; the derived atlas data/processed/mane_exon_atlas.tsv.gz IS the shipped deposit (panel Q10).

atlas_summary.definition_strict: CDS-overlapping exon of the MANE Select transcript that is neither the first nor the last CDS exon in transcript order.
atlas_summary.definition_s18rule: CDS-overlapping exon that is not the last CDS exon. Script 18's only exclusion is its variant-level in_last_exon == 0 filter; it has no first-exon exclusion, so this column mirrors the exon population script 18's tensor actually draws from.
atlas_summary.length_and_phase_basis: cds_length (CDS bases inside the exon). For every strict-internal exon in this atlas cds_length == exon_length (internal exons are fully coding), so length bins and phase are identical on either basis.

strand_validation.method: Script 18 rule replicated exactly: per gene, '+' if <2 PTC rows in ptc_features.tsv.gz or corr(genomic pos, round(ptc_frac*cds_len)) > 0, else '-'. Compared with the MANE Select strand in the atlas (GENCODE v46 GTF strand; identical to the MANE summary chr_strand for all 102).

reconstruction_replication_check.note: Replication is counted faithful for coordinate use if the (gene, length, symmetry, backup-skip) multiset matches the shipped candidates TSV; exon_id numbering itself can shift between genes with tied sort keys and is not compared.

coordinate_matching.method: Each replicated reconstructed internal exon (span = first/last observed coding-variant positions) was matched to the annotated CDS exon of the same gene whose CDS interval overlaps the span. A unique overlap is the annotated counterpart. Lengths compared are reconstructed span length (unrefined, as script 18 bins it) vs annotated CDS length.

no_overlap_characterization.explanation: These reconstructed 'exons' are clusters whose variants' VCF POS values fall outside every annotated CDS exon - predominantly single large deletions/complex indels whose POS sits in the intron just upstream of the exon their span disrupts (e.g. TSC2 chr16:2071508, POS 2 bp before the annotated exon start 2071510, REF spanning into the exon, classified frameshift). POS-only clustering turns each into a 1-bp intronic 'exon'.

multiset_comparison.method: Per gene, the sorted length list of reconstructed internal exons and of annotated strict-internal exons were paired by rank (shortest with shortest); unpaired tail exons are counted, not paired. This needs no coordinates and is the conservative cross-check on the overlap match.

hand_check_10.selection_rule: From reconstructed internal exons with a unique annotated counterpart: the TTN exon with the largest relative length error, then the largest-error exons from distinct genes up to 5 rows, then the smallest-error exons from further distinct genes up to 10 rows. The set spans >=5 genes, includes TTN, and includes >=2 minus-strand genes (checked in the data).
hand_check_10.d_junc_note: The shipped candidates TSV carries no coordinates, so d_junc cannot be hand-checked from shipped outputs alone. The reconstructed spans here come from this script's verified replication of script 18's clustering; for each exon the table gives the variants script 18 scores as junction-edge (d_junc <= 3 against reconstructed bounds) and the median of their TRUE annotated d_junc (distance to the annotated CDS bounds), which is what an edge call should have been.

annotated_tensor_comparison.method: Supp-table variants with mane_class_v46 == 'missense' were assigned to annotated internal coding exons by genomic position (pos inside the exon's annotated CDS interval, same gene). Length bin and phase symmetry (cds_length mod 3 == 0) come from the annotation. Backup skipping is script 18's own per-variant expr_backup_skips quantity, replicated from its shipped inputs (variant_transcript_sev + GTEx isoform usage, >=10% usage and >=1.0 TPM expressed alt transcript sparing the variant, propagated by script 18's nearest-position join) and held fixed between the two tensors, so the comparison isolates exon geometry. Cell variant counts use the variant-level flag (as script 18's do); cell exon counts use the exon-level max rule (as script 18's corrected tensor does).
annotated_tensor_comparison.what_is_missing_for_full_rederivation: Nothing for the 4x2x2 missense tensor itself: all 16 cells are re-derived above, and the annotated frame also carries its own likelihood-ratio table, bounding analysis, and CMH odds ratios with gene-cluster bootstrap CIs (annotated_lr_table / annotated_bounding / annotated_cmh). Two things remain un-re-derived and are NOT part of this tensor: (1) a from-scratch exon-level backup-skip definition independent of script 18's variant-level sparing propagation - the GTF-direct sensitivity below covers the length x skip margins under such a definition; (2) script 18's other variant-level quantities that consume reconstructed geometry (d_junc edge calls, the M6 architecture features, Tier-1 nomination scores) still rest on reconstructed spans and would need the same annotated re-assignment applied inside script 18.

annotated_bounding.method: Per cell: true P/LP rate is at least plp/missense_n (all unresolved benign) and at most (plp + unresolved)/missense_n (all unresolved pathogenic).

annotated_cmh.population: annotated internal resolved missense variants (strict-internal CDS exons, annotated length/phase)

gtf_direct_skip_sensitivity_length_x_ski.definition: Exon-level: 1 if an expressed (GTEx max usage >= 0.10, max median TPM >= 1.0) non-MANE protein-coding transcript of the same gene, taken from the GENCODE v46 GTF, has no exon overlapping the annotated exon's CDS interval.

limitations: Backup skipping in the annotated tensor is script 18's variant-level expr_backup_skips quantity (a GTEx transcript-abundance fraction, not junction PSI), replicated exactly and held fixed so the tensor comparison isolates exon geometry; the GTF-direct sensitivity is the only place a different skip definition enters.

The reconstruction replication is verified against the shipped candidates TSV as a (gene, length, symmetry, skip) multiset; reconstructed spans are therefore as script 18 computed them on the pinned stack, but exon_id numbering is not compared and may shift between genes.
Annotated assignment uses the supp table's mane_class_v46 == 'missense' set (the same variant population as script 18's tensor) and its clnsig_aggregate resolved labels, unchanged.
Phase symmetry uses annotated CDS length mod 3 (not script 18's refine_bounds-adjusted span); for strict-internal exons CDS length equals full exon length in this atlas.
